description: Immersive whole-tree felling for Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric + NeoForge). Trees topple as rigid pendulums, crush what stands in their path, shower leaves, and never bounce.

mods.name: Bucheron
mods.description: Fell a whole tree in one cut. The trunk topples under its own weight, crushes whatever stands in its path, showers leaves as it sweeps down, and stops dead on impact. Bigger trees take longer to cut and cost more durability, and cutting bare-handed is a decision you will regret.
